app.title: Galactic Soup
app.tagline: A single-player space trading, exploration and combat game.
shell.status.label: Engine status
shell.note.noCampaign: No campaign systems are installed yet. This build verifies the application shell, the engine worker and the protocol gateway.
compatibility.heading: Galactic Soup cannot start
compatibility.detail: The game runs its engine in a dedicated browser worker. Without one it cannot keep your campaign correct, so it will not continue.
compatibility.advice: Use a current desktop version of a Chromium-based browser or Firefox, and allow the page to run scripts and workers.
error.compatibility.workerUnsupported: This browser does not provide the dedicated worker the engine needs.
error.compatibility.workerFailed: The engine worker could not be started.
error.gateway.timeout: The engine did not answer in time.
error.gateway.transportFailed: The connection to the engine failed.
error.gateway.disposed: The connection to the engine was closed.
error.gateway.duplicateRequestId: A request with the same identifier is already in flight.
error.gateway.malformedResponse: The engine sent a response that could not be read.
error.invalidRequest.notAnObject: The request was not a protocol message.
error.invalidRequest.protocolVersion: The request used protocol version {received}; this engine speaks version {expected}.
error.invalidRequest.requestId: The request identifier was missing or longer than {maxLength} characters.
error.invalidRequest.requestType: The request did not name a request type.
error.invalidRequest.campaignId: The request named an invalid campaign.
error.invalidRequest.expectedRevision: The expected revision was not a whole, non-negative number.
error.invalidRequest.payload: The request payload was not valid ({reason}).
error.invalidRequest.unknownField: The request contained the unexpected field {field}.
error.invalidRequest.unsupportedRequestT: This engine does not support the request type {type}.
error.invalidRequest.nonTransportableVal: The value at {path} cannot cross the engine boundary ({reason}).
error.staleRevision: The campaign changed while the action was being prepared.
error.stalePreview: The preview is out of date and must be recalculated.
error.ruleViolation: That action is not allowed right now.
error.notFound: The requested entity or definition does not exist.
error.contentError: The installed game content is not valid.
error.saveError: The campaign could not be saved.
error.quotaError: There is not enough local storage space to save the campaign.
error.integrityError: The saved campaign failed its integrity check.
error.internalError: The engine stopped an action to protect the campaign.
